notes.title: Languages Update + Trading Cards & More
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40512862/8f84db95ecfe3da5e0eeab527cb3eb07fe6965b4.jpg[/img]
[h1]Localisation[/h1]
Wonderful members of the community have helped to localise the game into several new languages! [b]Shashingo now supports learning Japanese from:[/b]
[h3][list]
[*] [b]French[/b]  [i](Français)[/i]
[*] [b]German[/b]  [i](Deutsch)[/i]
[*] [b]Spanish (EU)[/b]  [i](Español (EU))[/i]
[*] [b]Spanish (Latin American)[/b]  [i](Español (LAT.))[/i]
[*] [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b]  [i](português brasileiro)[/i]
[*] [b]Simplified Chinese[/b]  [i](简体中文)[/i]
[/list][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40512862/5b24cf1cd452931c3314abdd9402bf12d4460236.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40512862/db62b19e0859d4fd0a1e1b0cb6027b998be148f7.jpg[/img]

We hope that this allows more of you to study Japanese with your native language rather than having to rely on what you know in English.

[i]As this has been a community effort, we would appreciate if you could share with us any issues you may find in the new languages over on our Discord server or on the Steam Forums.[/i]

[h2]Romaji + Kana[/h2]
Added Romaji + Kana option for viewing the flash cards! This is good for beginners if you are not yet comfortable with hiragana and katakana!

[h2]Steam Trading Cards[/h2]
You can now collect Steam trading cards for Shashingo! Collecting complete sets will allow you to earn and level up a Shashingo specific badge that has cool artwork, and earn new chat emoticons and user profile backgrounds! You can earn trading cards by playing the game, or purchase them via the marketplace from other users.

[h2]Minor Updates[/h2]
- Minor optimization improvements
- Some small text/clipping bugs fixed
- A few Japanese words adjusted for clarity
- Added control swapping for AZERTY/QWERTZ keyboards

Thank you again for your support!
- Ryan

notes.title: Movement Speed Increase & Motion-Sickness Reduction & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Movement speed has been increased
[*] Running speed has been increased
[*] Gameplay options menu now includes a WIP "Motion-Sickness Reduction" setting.
[/list]
[h3]Motion-Sickness Reduction[/h3]
[i]This setting removes the offset of the camera and sets the pivot point to the centre point of the player. In theory this should help reduce feelings of nausea, but has not been thoroughly tested. Please let me know if this has helped![/i]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
Fixed: Cars should no longer clip into each other.
Fixed: Difficulties stepping into the butchers shop on low frame rates.
Fixed: Rain would sometimes randomly occur when not supposed to.
Fixed: Favourite button could be pressed on an photo empty slot. (Controller Input)
Fixed: Small visual glitch for 1 frame when swapping borders on new photos.
Fixed: Audio button input overlapping with take photo input in find mode. (Controller Input)
Fixed: Quiz mode could be skipped with the page turn button after page 1. (Controller Input)

notes.title: Small Hotfix

notes.title: Flash-Card Viewer Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40512862/a600bf6613d834b1b06c934fba90f52d908ad096.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Photo Flash-Card Viewer[/h1]
Many of you wanted to view your photo flash-cards from your album in full-screen just like when you make new ones. So I've included a new way to view them in the photo album!

When playing with keyboard/mouse, simply [b]middle mouse click[/b] one of your cards and you'll be able to see it much larger on the screen. If you're playing with a controller instead, use the [b]right trigger[/b] when focused on the photo flash-card you want to view. On controller, you're also able to move left and right between the photos on the page you are viewing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40512862/f5d2e741ba3c656324ed7a07a4d63f588f6fd7af.jpg[/img]
[h2]Day/Night Transition Slowed Down[/h2]
Many players said they love the sky's colours when the world transitions between day and night, but it was too fast to snap a nice photo. The transition time has now been increased so you can enjoy it a little longer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40512862/e0b718d68e575a0c1648ad1df8addba696b99c27.jpg[/img]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Windowed full-screen was locking the mouse to the frame when it shouldn't have been.
[*] The bridge was visually not aligned properly to the road.
[*] Tree LODs have been adjusted to look better visually.
[*] Controller allowed some menu options to continue scrolling when past the final option, causing further bugs.
[*] Find-Mode could be replayed with the "weak" word set when the amount was higher than your actual amount of weak words after getting an answer correct in the previous session.
[*] Quiz mode duration was incorrect and never properly reset.
[*] One of the popup translations by the arcade was linked to the wrong sentence.
[*] Standardized "Reading & Listening" and "Reading + Listening".
[*] Coffee in the vending machine now counts as "Coffee".
[*] [spoiler]Ghost was missing it's highlight/focusing in find-mode.[/spoiler]
[/list]

Thanks for playing,
Ryan!

notes.title: 'Quiz Mode' & More Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40512862/f7e526d9e58525061348f0e99eb25bdffc14aba5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Introducing 'Quiz Mode'[/h1]
Quiz Mode lets you study the vocabulary that you learn on the back of your Photo Flash-Cards!
You can set up a study session in-game and answer multiple choice questions to earn more coins for buying Filters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40512862/619f6d365bc323299f2a48980bd4a4de49546bfd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Export Your Photos[/h1]
You can now export your favourite photos as .jpegs and transparent .png flash-cards!
[i]If you have any issues with this feature, please let me know in the Discord or Steam discussions area![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40512862/84946e053b13e7c4cc1c2e44424c559625cb6acf.png[/img]

[h2]Incorrect Answers Now Shown After Find Mode![/h2]
Your incorrect answers will now be given as a list at the end of a session of Find Mode ([i]and the new Quiz Mode![/i]), so you'll know which words you'll need to study more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40512862/e86e33661bc95ef03789e2a7e214bc8f52c0cad9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Reading & Listening Setting[/h2]
Find Mode & Quiz Mode now let you swap between Reading & Listening, Reading or Listening modes so you can practice the way you want to!

[h2]Extra Answers Accepted in Find Mode[/h2]
Some words in Shashingo could technically have different multiple "correct" answers when you make a guess. Now, some words will accept a few additional answers when photographed.

[i]For example: If you are searching for "food / tabemono", you can now answer with a photo of an "egg / tamago"[/i]

I understand how annoying it must've been to take a photograph of a cherry blossom tree and it be marked incorrect for "tree." It's now possible!!

[h2]Pop-up Translation Size Slider[/h2]
In the settings menu you can now change the size of the in-world pop-up translations!

[h2]Invert X or Y-Axis[/h2]
Many users asked for this option, so here it is! The setting words for both controllers and mouse input.

[h3]Updated Tutorial Images[/h3]
One or two tutorial images have been updated for clarity, as some users are missing out on some of the game's features.

[h3]Added The 2 Karaoke Songs to the Credits[/h3]
[i]Additional Kickstarter backers will be added to the credits soon too.[/i]

[i]Plus various other bug fixes![/i]

Thanks for playing,
Ryan!
